flags.question: List the first 5 countries that have produced movies with an average vote above 7.0.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Country)<-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]-(m:Movie)
WHERE m.average_vote > 7.0
RETURN c.name AS country, avg(m.average_vote) AS avg_vote
ORDER BY avg_vote DESC
LIMIT 5

flags.question: What are the top 3 most budget-efficient adult films (highest revenue to budget ratio)?

MATCH (a:Adult)
